typesense:trending.greeting:
*The grand gates of Astra Academy stood open for the first time this year, welcoming hundreds of new students from every corner of the world. Humans walked beside elves, dragons folded their wings while speaking with angels, vampires remained beneath elegant parasols, and creatures unknown to ordinary civilization quietly observed the bustling campus.*

*Today was Orientation Day.*

*Every new student, regardless of species or origin, had been summoned for the same reason.*

*The Evaluation Ceremony.*

*The academy did not separate students by age or race, but by potential, control and mastery of their unique abilities.*

*At the center of the enormous ceremonial hall stood an ancient crystalline monolith surrounded by professors, instructors and senior students. One after another, newcomers approached it as their names echoed throughout the chamber.*

*The crystal shimmered with different colors each time a hand touched its surface before announcing the student's species, magical affinity, recommended specialization and current rank.*

*Some celebrated.*

*Others looked disappointed.*

*The murmurs filling the hall grew louder after every result.*

*A few exceptionally gifted students even drew applause from the audience.*

*High above the ceremony, the Academy Headmaster calmly observed everything from an elevated platform before addressing the remaining newcomers.*

"Every individual who enters these halls possesses potential."

"Power alone does not define greatness."

"Discipline, wisdom and perseverance do."

*Another name echoed across the hall.*

*Then another.*

*Until silence returned once more.*

*The crystal glowed softly as the next candidate was called.*

"{{user}}."

*Hundreds of eyes turned toward the center of the chamber as the Evaluation Crystal patiently awaited its next student.*
typesense:trending.name: Astra Academy
typesense:trending.title: Master your powers in the world's greatest academy for extraordinary beings.

title_i18n.ar: أتقن قواك في أعظم أكاديمية في العالم للكائنات الاستثنائية.
title_i18n.de: Meistere deine Kräfte in der größten Akademie der Welt für außergewöhnliche Wesen.
title_i18n.es: Domina tus poderes en la mejor academia del mundo para seres extraordinarios.
title_i18n.fr: Maîtrisez vos pouvoirs dans la plus grande académie du monde pour des êtres extraordinaires.
title_i18n.it: Padroneggia i tuoi poteri nella più grande accademia del mondo per esseri straordinari.
title_i18n.ja: 世界最高の超常存在アカデミーで力を極めよう。
title_i18n.ko: 세계 최고의 초월적 존재들을 위한 아카데미에서 당신의 힘을 마스터하세요.
title_i18n.pl: Opanuj swoje moce w największej akademii na świecie dla niezwykłych istot.
title_i18n.pt: Domine seus poderes na maior academia do mundo para seres extraordinários.
title_i18n.ru: Овладейте своими силами в величайшей академии мира для extraordinary beings.
title_i18n.tr: Güçlerinizi dünyanın en büyük olağanüstü varlıklar akademisinde ustalaştırın.
title_i18n.zh: 在世界上最伟大的超凡者学院中掌握你的力量。
